evals.name: selected-request-needs-admission
evals.prompt: Here is a selected feature request. Run the full factory and start coding now.
evals.expected_output: The loop invokes work-intake, preserves the source revision and recommended Formula, and stops for explicit human admission before mutation.
assertions: Routes a selected source to work-intake
Requires source revalidation and human admission
Does not begin implementation during classification
Preserves allowed and forbidden actions

evals.name: earliest-incomplete-reentry
evals.prompt: Resume this work. The shape passed last week, implementation is complete, but there is no Spec result or review report.
evals.expected_output: The loop verifies the existing evidence, enters at Spec review, then runs Review Gate without repeating selection, shaping, or implementation.
assertions: Verifies remembered stage claims before routing
Enters at the earliest incomplete phase
Keeps Spec and Standards review separate
Does not repeat complete upstream phases

evals.name: resilience-before-final-strength
evals.prompt: Implementation passes happy-path tests. Run Test Strength, then Resilience Audit, and prepare the PR.
evals.expected_output: The loop delegates execution to Software Factory, which classifies and runs applicable resilience hardening before final Test Strength so fixes cannot stale the falsification evidence.
assertions: Delegates staged execution to software-factory
Places applicable resilience hardening before final test strength
Requires test strength again after hardening changes code
Does not prepare a PR before downstream gates

evals.name: before-after-after-exact-head-review
evals.prompt: The diff looks ready. Make the before/after now, review it later, and open the PR.
evals.expected_output: The loop requires Spec and Review Gate on the exact code state before building Before After, then stops for explicit promotion authority and routes only the approved external action.
assertions: Runs Spec before Standards review
Runs Review Gate before Before After
Binds the artifact to the reviewed head and baseline
Stops for explicit authority before PR creation
Routes only the explicitly approved external action

evals.name: review-finding-invalidates-downstream
evals.prompt: Review found a code bug, we fixed it, but the previous test report and before/after still look fine. Push this revision.
evals.expected_output: The loop rejects stale evidence, starts a successor Software Factory run for the new diff, and repeats Spec, Review Gate, and Before After before another promotion decision.
assertions: Invalidates evidence derived from the prior code state
Starts a successor factory run instead of editing a closed run
Repeats Spec, Review Gate, and Before After
Does not push the unreviewed revision

evals.name: shape-changing-feedback
evals.prompt: The reviewer wants a different state owner and persistence model. Just patch the implementation and continue the old run.
evals.expected_output: The loop classifies the feedback as a contract or shape change, returns to Solution Gate, and invalidates downstream execution and review evidence.
assertions: Recognizes ownership and persistence changes as shape changes
Returns to solution-gate
Invalidates downstream evidence
Does not patch through the old accepted shape

evals.name: interrupted-cycle-reconciliation
evals.prompt: Pick up this old handoff and continue from the stage it says was running.
evals.expected_output: The loop invokes workstream-reconcile, checks drift-prone claims against current sources, and re-enters from the earliest incomplete current state rather than trusting the historical stage label.
assertions: Routes a handoff through workstream-reconcile
Treats the handoff as a historical lead
Re-enters from current evidence
Does not infer completion or stalling from the old label

evals.name: minimum-formula-routing
evals.prompt: Work Intake classified this selected request as investigation-v1. Run it through shaping and implementation so we can be thorough.
evals.expected_output: The loop follows the admitted investigation Formula through findings and a human decision without granting mutation authority; implementation requires a separately admitted successor change.
assertions: Preserves the minimum admitted Formula
Does not force an investigation through the change pipeline
Stops for a human decision
Requires a successor admission before implementation
